question: What shape and proportional measure must the back part of the altar assume?
premises: The back part of the altar is specified as the subject.
Its measure is defined as six parts.
The prescribed form for this part is that of a tortoise.
inference: The back part of the altar, measuring six parts, should be tortoise-shaped.
plain_english: The back part of the altar, measuring six parts, should be in the form of a tortoise.
